verses.50:19: وَجَآءَتۡ سَكۡرَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنۡهُ تَحِيدُ

meaning: The root حيد (Hyd) refers to a prominent, protuberant, or projecting part of something. It can describe a knot in wood, a curved bone, a knot in a horn, or a projecting ledge of a mountain.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
